## Answer

I read the invoices.csv file from the working directory. The file contains invoice data with columns: id, customer, amount, and status. I located the row containing INV-1021 (line 23 of the file):

```
INV-1021,Helios SA,1797,open
```

This shows that invoice INV-1021 is for customer **Helios SA**, with an amount of 1797 and status "open".
